Medical Care App

A single platform that connects patients with doctors and makes hospitals, laboratories and pharmacies easier to reach. The goal was to take the steps out of finding and contacting care, including a one-tap emergency request.

The interface is right-to-left and covers sign-in, specialty search, doctor profiles, booking, maps and the patient account across more than 60 screens.

My role
Interface and experience design, plus a secure API for data exchange and the database for medical services and user data.
Stack
Figma, React, Node.js, Flask, Flutter (Dart), MySQL
Outcome
One multi-interface solution that improves communication between patients and care providers.
Graduation projectIoTTeam of six2025–2026

Smart Cane for the Blind

A white cane that detects obstacles, tracks its location and streams video to a caregiver's phone. Conventional canes cannot warn about hazards beyond arm's reach or share where the user is. This one does both.

An ESP32-CAM reads an ultrasonic sensor and a GPS module, sounds a buzzer when something is close, and sends location and live video to a mobile app.

Hardware
ESP32-CAM, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, NEO-6M GPS, active buzzer, 18650 batteries
Detection
2–400 cm range with an alert at 50 cm
Format
24-slide defence deck covering the problem, architecture, circuit, firmware, testing and results
